## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: bug-report-template.md lists the 7 allowed values verbatim

Modify `plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/bug-report-template.md`:

1. Add a new `## detected_by Field` section that lists all 7 allowed detected_by channel values verbatim: tests, review-llm, review-human, production, user-report, internal-dogfood, other. The values MUST match EXACTLY the ALLOWED array in plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh.

2. Do NOT remove the existing CLI_user note (current line 147) — extend or reference it; preserve all existing template content.

Per Rule 5, this is a prompt template (instruction file) — structural tests only.

## Testing Mode
RED — write structural tests (grep-based assertions) first; they fail because the template currently has no detected_by section. Then add the section to make them pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Template contains a `## detected_by Field` section heading — Verify: grep -qE '^## detected_by Field' plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/bug-report-template.md
- Template lists all 7 allowed detected_by values verbatim — Verify: for v in tests review-llm review-human production user-report internal-dogfood other; do grep -q -- "$v" plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/bug-report-template.md || { echo "MISSING: $v"; exit 1; }; done
- Template values match the ALLOWED array in infer-detected-by.sh — Verify: for v in $(grep -oE 'ALLOWED=\([^)]+\)' plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh | tr -d '"()' | sed 's/ALLOWED=//'); do grep -q -- "$v" plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/bug-report-template.md || { echo "MISSING from template: $v"; exit 1; }; done
- Pre-existing CLI_user note is preserved (not removed) — Verify: grep -q 'CLI_user' plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/bug-report-template.md
- Template is valid markdown (file exists, non-empty) — Verify: test -s plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/bug-report-template.md
